title: Christmas Tree Fruit Platter
description: This recipe is a festive way to serve fruit at your next holiday gathering — arrange your fruit in the shape of a Christmas tree as a lovely centerpiece.

steps.text: Create an outline of a tree shape on a cutting board or serving platter with grapes. Beginning at top tree point, fan grapes into a triangular pattern. Create 3 triangular sections, each slightly larger than the last; fill in each section with kiwi slices.
Arrange sliced strawberries across tree shape to create a garland effect. Add pomegranate seeds randomly over arranged fruit to look like ornaments.
Cut pineapple slices into a star shape and several small ornament shapes using small cookie cutters. Place pineapple star at top of tree shape; decorate rest of tree with pineapple ornaments.
Arrange dates at bottom of tree to look like a trunk. Serve immediately, or keep refrigerated until ready to serve.
